title: Role of stem cells in maxillary sinus floor augmentation: meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
html: The aim of this systematic review was to compare the effectiveness of stem cell-based grafts versus conventional bone graft materials in maxillary sinus floor augmentation. A comprehensive literature search was conducted across Scopus, Cochrane, Embase, Web of Science, and Wiley Online Library, and was supplemented by manual searches in Google Scholar, the gray literature, and reference lists, following PRISMA 2020 and Cochrane guidelines. Fifteen randomized controlled trials involving 205 patients met the inclusion criteria.
